text:
maria: Heads-up — GCP marketplace payout for March looks off vs our reserved credits. Our internal ledger shows ~ $42,870 expected net but reported net payout is $21,435 (short by ~$21,435). Can anyone eyeball?
ajay: Which invoice/statement are you comparing?
maria: Statement/Invoice: INV-2026-03-31-9987. Quick extract below: ```INV-2026-03-31-9987: marketplace gross $184,532
Commitment credit (partner path): -$163,097
Net payout reported by GCP: $21,435
Ledger expected net: $42,870
Discrepancy: -$21,435```
kevin: Is this via the reseller route or direct? Reseller routing sometimes reflows credits into partner payouts.
maria: @kevin it's under partner id `PR-5573` (redwood-reseller-01). Commitment id `CMT-8342`. My suspicion is the commitment offset applied but the partner fee / payout routing caused the remainder to be forwarded to partner channel.
billing-bot: New statement uploaded: gs://redwood-billing/gcp/2026/03/INV-2026-03-31-9987.pdf — parsed rows: /billing/statements/2026/03/31/INV-9987.json
olivia: Quick checklist: 1) commitment window active? (should be 2026-03-01 → 2026-05-31) 2) SKU mapping — GCP sometimes reports different SKU ids and our ingestion can misclassify GPU vs non-GPU usage.
ajay: One thing: our ledger used posting date 2026-03-30 for recognition; GCP statement posts 2026-03-31. Could be a 1-day timing reflow into Apr depending on settlement rules. I'll run the month-end bucket script to confirm.
maria: If it's just timing we're fine, but if credits routed to partner payout channel we need partner reconciliation docs. @kevin can you escalate to partner AM / GCP rep?
kevin: Will do. Opening case with GCP marketplace: CASE-20260331-GCP-PR5573. Asking for partner routing breakdown and any partner-side credit application.
olivia: Also please file a FIN ticket for audit trail. @ajay can you create FIN-5421 with ledger diff + parsed rows?
ajay: Done — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/FIN-5421. Attached ledger extract, parsed statement, and a diff CSV. Assigning to @kevin to follow up with GCP.
maria: :thumbsup: Target EOD for an initial confirmation. If partner routed credits incorrectly we'll request reversal / manual reflow.
billing-bot: Reminder — automatic settlement runs Tue 04:00 UTC. Missing this cycle will push the effect into April statements.
kevin: Quick update from GCP support: they see a partner credit flag that routed the $21,435 into the partner payout channel. They requested partner reconciliation docs; partner finance needs to confirm acceptance. ETA 48h.
maria: Thanks — please paste partner docs when available. If partner doesn't accept we request reversal. Keep this thread updated.
kevin: Will update here.
olivia: Noted. Also let's add a small check to the ingestion that flags partner-id credit routing mismatches next month to avoid manual triage.
maria: Agreed. Filing a follow-up PR to the billing parser after we close FIN-5421.
